name: tavily
description: Web search, content extraction, crawling, deep research, and URL discovery. MCP tools plus skills; CLI for terminal agents.

skills.name: tavily-best-practices
skills.description: Build production-ready Tavily integrations with best practices baked in. Reference documentation for developers using coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to implement web search, content extraction, crawling, and research in agentic workflows, RAG systems, or autonomous

skills.name: tavily-cli
skills.description: Install and authenticate the Tavily CLI (`tvly`) in a coding-agent terminal. Use only when the user asks to install tvly, run tvly login, or check CLI status, or when a terminal session has no callable Tavily MCP tools. Not for ordinary web search, extraction, mapping, crawling,

skills.name: tavily-crawl
skills.description: Collect content from many pages on the same site. Use when the user wants to crawl, download docs, extract a whole section such as /docs, bulk-extract pages, or says "get all the pages" or "extract everything under".

skills.name: tavily-extract
skills.description: Extract clean content from known URLs. Use when the user supplies one or more URLs and wants the page text, says "extract", "grab the content from", "pull the text from", "get the page at", or "read this webpage".

skills.name: tavily-map
skills.description: Discover URLs on a known website without extracting page content. Use when the user wants the site structure, to find a specific page on a large site, or says "map the site", "list the pages", "what URLs are on", or "find the docs URL".

skills.name: tavily-research
skills.description: Produce cited multi-source research. Use when the user wants a deep report, comparison, market analysis, or literature review, or says "research", "investigate", "analyze in depth", "compare X vs Y", or "what does the market look like for". For a quick fact, use tavily-search ins

skills.name: tavily-search
skills.description: Search the web for current sources and snippets. Use when the user wants to search, look up, find articles, get recent news, or discover sources, and does not already have a URL. Triggers: "search for", "look up", "find me", "what's the latest on", "find articles about".

commands.name: tavily-setup
commands.description: Set up the Tavily plugin (connect MCP or install CLI and authenticate)

commands.name: search
commands.description: Web search for a given query (default for most research queries). Usage: /search <query>

commands.name: extract
commands.description: URL content extraction for webpages, articles, PDFs. Usage: /extract <url>

commands.name: map
commands.description: Discover URLs on a website without extracting content. Usage: /map <url>

commands.name: crawl
commands.description: Crawl a website and extract content from multiple pages. Usage: /crawl <url>

commands.name: research
commands.description: Exhaustive multi-source research on a topic (slower, use only when explicitly requested). Usage: /research <topic>

commands.name: tavily-status
commands.description: Check Tavily MCP or CLI readiness. Usage: /tavily-status

commands.name: tavily-best-practices
commands.description: Reference documentation for building production-ready Tavily integrations. Usage: /tavily-best-practices <topic>
